rules.P1: Every stack contains at least one yellow object.
rules.P2: Every large square has a small object resting directly on top of it.
rules.P3: No large object rests on a small object.
rules.P4: No triangle is in a stack to the left of any circle (all circles are left of all triangles).
rules.P5: The scene contains at least one large yellow object.
rules.P6: There are more red objects than blue objects.
rules.P7: The total number of objects in the scene is odd.
rules.P8: Every triangle rests directly on a blue object.
